stable_recovery_definition: Earliest post-visible fresh output after which all subsequent 500-ms windows until the next occlusion/end have translation P95 <= max(10 mm, 2x pre-occlusion P95) and rotation P95 <= max(8 deg, 2x pre-occlusion P95).
harmful_candidate_definition: Raw capture-aligned candidate translation error >20 mm OR rotation error >10 deg.
harmful_output_jump_definition: Per-render translation jump >10 mm OR rotation jump >5 deg.
inference_policy: Paired descriptive effects across seven occlusions; no frame-level or population-level significance claim.
